episodes.title: ISSUE #101: How Do You Raise a Superhero?
episodes.summary: Widowed mom Nicole struggles to raise her only child Dion, not knowing the second-grader possesses powers beyond anyone's comprehension.

episodes.title: ISSUE #102: Fortress of Solitude
episodes.summary: Dion's powers continue to perplex an increasingly on-edge Nicole. Pat volunteers to investigate a possible lead into Mark's past.

episodes.title: ISSUE #103: Watch Man
episodes.summary: Following a run-in at school, Nicole has a difficult but necessary conversation with her son. A mysterious figure from Mark's past resurfaces.

episodes.title: ISSUE #104: Welcome to BIONA. Hope You Survive the Experience
episodes.summary: As Nicole tries to track down the person behind an ominous photo, Pat takes Dion to BIONA, where they see a few things not on the official tour.

episodes.title: ISSUE #105: Days of Mark's Future Past
episodes.summary: The life-altering events surrounding Mark's past come into focus. Nicole struggles to give Dion his dream birthday. Esperanza makes a discovery.

episodes.title: ISSUE #106: Super Friends
episodes.summary: Nicole gets reacquainted with an old passion. Charlotte offers to take Dion under her wing. Pat gets some unexpected news at work.

episodes.title: ISSUE #107: Why So Vomity?
episodes.summary: When Dion is taken to the hospital with a mysterious ailment, Nicole and Pat worry his powers may be discovered.

episodes.title: ISSUE #108: You Won't Like Him When He's Angry
episodes.summary: Nicole puts everything on the line to rescue Dion from Suzanne and BIONA. Later, Charlotte uncovers a terrifying truth.

episodes.title: ISSUE #109: Storm Killer
episodes.summary: With the crooked man closing in and a final confrontation seemingly inevitable, a terrified Nicole tries to protect Dion by fleeing the city.

episodes.title: ISSUE #201: A Hero Returns
episodes.summary: Two years after clashing with the Crooked Man, Dion tries to live a normal life while developing his powers. A new student joins Dion's class.

episodes.title: ISSUE #202: Sankofa
episodes.summary: A figure from Nicole's past returns, causing chaos and confusion. Dion shows new classmate Brayden the ropes. Sparks fly between Nicole and Tevin.

episodes.title: ISSUE #203: Monster Problem
episodes.summary: Using their powers, Dion and Brayden ditch school — sort of. David takes an interest in Pat's potential. Esperanza battles nerves at the auditions.

episodes.title: ISSUE #204: With Friends Like These
episodes.summary: BIONA tries to bring a mysterious sinkhole under control. Nicole's infection worsens. Dion's playdate with Brayden takes an unexpected turn.

episodes.title: ISSUE #205: You vs. Me
episodes.summary: Brayden pays Pat a surprise visit. Kat and Tevin take Dion to the country. Worried the infection may spread, Nicole self-isolates.

episodes.title: ISSUE #206: 36 Good Hours
episodes.summary: Nicole receives some devastating news and Pat gets a rude awakening. Meanwhile, the Crooked Man takes things with Brayden to a terrifying new level.

episodes.title: ISSUE #207: World Without Mom
episodes.summary: As Pat clings to life, Nicole resolves to share a special day with Dion. At BIONA, David gives a major presentation and Simone makes a move.

episodes.title: ISSUE #208: Who You Are
episodes.summary: It's Esperanza's big night, but Dion and Nicole soon find themselves in a dangerous showdown against a familiar villain and his army.
